title: sshd in OpenSSH before 10.6p2 on Linux, when musl libc is used without PAM, lacks a workaround for a password…
description: OpenSSH versions before 10.6p2 on Linux systems using musl libc without PAM are vulnerable to a password authentication bypass. This flaw arises from a misinterpretation of whether a string is a password hash, allowing passwords between 256 and 1024 characters to succeed improperly. Alpine Linux is an example of a platform affected by this issue.
